name: Helix editor
description: Installs the Helix terminal editor (`hx`) at build time from helix-editor/helix's own release tarball — by default the latest release, resolved at build time rather than a version this repo tracks — with its prebuilt tree-sitter grammars and queries, and sets HELIX_RUNTIME to them. Language servers are not installed: Helix uses whichever ones are on PATH (`hx --health` lists them). Sets no EDITOR: `export EDITOR=hx` is yours to choose.

version.description: Helix release to install. 'latest' resolves the newest release from helix-editor/helix at build time — this repo does not pin or track a version. Otherwise a release tag as GitHub names it, such as '25.07.1'.
